milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The brown wall banner is on the interior north wall at (0,2,2) facing south — visible from spawn. Max_distance=5 is acceptable as this is the introductory orientation task. WHY position_near_with_facing: the object is pre-placed and the player must visually locate it by facing toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The cyan terracotta walls form the nether corridor center at (-7,1,0). From spawn distance is 7.07 blocks which exceeds max_distance=5, forcing the player to walk into the corridor. WHY position_near_with_facing: the block is pre-placed and the player must navigate to and observe it.

Uses inventory_has because mining magma_block with the provided diamond pickaxe drops the magma_block item into inventory. Magma blocks are on the corridor floor at y=0. WHY inventory_has: the mined block ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The spruce door is at (3,1,0) on the east wall. From spawn distance is 3.16 blocks which exceeds max_distance=2, forcing the player to walk to the door. WHY position_near_with_facing: the door is pre-placed and the player must navigate to it and face it.

Uses inventory_has because breaking sugar cane drops the sugar_cane item into inventory instantly. Sugar cane is in the garden at (8,0,-1) and (7,0,0) on grass adjacent to water. WHY inventory_has: the harvested item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The red mushroom block is at (9,0,1) in the garden wing. From spawn distance is 9.06 blocks which far exceeds max_distance=4, forcing navigation through the spruce door into the garden. WHY position_near_with_facing: the block is pre-placed and the player must navigate to and observe it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The green bed head is at (7,0,7) in the enclosed bedroom, only accessible through the garden's south opening. From spawn distance is 9.90 blocks which far exceeds max_distance=4. WHY position_near_with_facing: the bed is pre-placed and the player must navigate through multiple rooms to observe it.

Uses inventory_has because breaking pink_wool drops the pink_wool block item into inventory. Wool drops itself when broken by any means. Pink wool is at (9,0,5), (10,0,5), and (9,0,8) in the bedroom. WHY inventory_has: the mined block ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task. The polished granite slab walkway center is at (13,0,2). From spawn distance is 13.15 blocks which far exceeds max_distance=4, enforcing navigation through garden to east exit. Facing tolerance increased to 70 degrees since slabs are at floor level. WHY position_near_with_facing: the slabs are pre-placed and the player must navigate to and observe them.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia_button (1 acacia plank in any crafting grid) places the result in inventory. Acacia planks are in the chest at (13,0,4) and a crafting table is at (13,0,3). WHY inventory_has: the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.
